author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing was a ring head with a square knob on top over T-shaped shoulders; the original's hood framing the face and the pointed bandana over the lower face were missing.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. The hood crown and sides frame a shield-shaped face opening with a bandana line and pointed mask; matches the reference silhouette. A flared-shoulder SQUARE variant (attempts/) was rejected: its small flare looked pinched.
omissions: Eyes (no 8-unit room in the eye band) and shoulder flare below the hood.
human_reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg; hood and shoulders are one continuous garment silhouette, face opening detached inside with 10u centerline clearance.
